messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — onboarding flow for Private VPC customers is returning intermittent 401s right after SSO exchange. Not yet sure of scope but we have ~10 active onboarders flagged by AMs. Need comms plan and owner for outbound notices. Incident ID INC-2026-042.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-042 created — status: investigating — link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042 :rotating_light:

Maria: I see spikes in 401s from the SAML proxy -> auth-router. Reproduced locally: cert reload + brief clock skew causes our auth library to reject assertions. Rolling a restart of auth-router on the affected cluster now. ETA ~20m. No evidence of token leakage.

Priya: Confirming no tokens exfiltrated. Root cause looks like cert reload race + time-drift. We'll include security note in the RCA.

Lee: For outbound to onboarding customers, suggest two messages: (1) immediate short notice acknowledging issue + ETA, (2) follow-up RCA once fixed. Draft for (1) below — copy as needed.

Lee: "Hi <customer>, we detected intermittent 401 errors affecting SSO-based onboarding in Private VPC deployments. Our engineers are investigating and we've started mitigation; most affected users see onboarding resumes within ~20–30 minutes. No PII or tokens were accessed. We'll follow up with a full post-incident summary. If this is impacting your launch today please reply and we’ll prioritize. — Redwood CS"

Oliver: I'll coordinate with AMs for renewal-risk accounts and offer one-month onboarding credits if the outage materially affects launch commitments. Please DM me the 10-account list.

Sasha: DMing the list now (internal). Need a short public status blurb for status page and an internal playbook for CS to triage live demos. Who will post status?

Maria: Patch deployed at 1952467960 — changed cert reload behavior to drain inflight auth ops and added a time-sync check before accepting SAML assertions. Error rate down ~90% in the next 3 minutes. Continuing to monitor.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigating (updated at 1952467985)

Priya: RCA draft notes for CS: root cause — cert reload race combined with up-to-30s clock skew on a subset of hosts caused assertion validation failures (401). Fixes: graceful reload, time-sync guard, and added alerting for sudden auth error spikes. Postmortem ETA: EOD today.

Lee: Full customer email template (post-fix) — feel free to copy/paste: 

"Hi <CustomerName>,

We want to let you know we experienced intermittent SSO (401) errors impacting some Private VPC onboarding flows earlier today. Our engineers identified a cert reload race interacting with clock skew which caused assertion validation to fail. We deployed a fix and restarted the auth-router; onboarding resumed for most customers within ~20 minutes.

What we did: applied a graceful reload for certs, added a time-sync guard to the auth path, and put new alerting in place.

Impact: up to ~10 onboarding customers experienced temporary failures; no user data or tokens were exposed.

Next steps: a full post-incident report will be published to the status page by EOD. If you had an immediate launch impacted, reply and we’ll escalate priority for remediation credits and onboarding support.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success"

Sasha: That looks good — concise and empathetic. Oliver, please handle the renewal-risk templates with the AMs. Lee & I will send the onboarding notices to the flagged accounts within the hour.

Oliver: On it. Reaching out to AMs now and updating the renewal-risk tracker. :thumbsup:

Maria: Monitoring shows healthy auth traffic for 15 minutes. I'll keep a 30m watch and then close the bridge if stable. Also opened PR for the graceful-reload fix and test cases for time-skew scenarios.

Sasha: Thanks everyone. I’ll post the short status update on the public page and send the outbound emails. Will close this thread once postmortem is scheduled and the EOD note is posted.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: monitoring
